M3: Any regularization-dependent quantity presented as universal, or failure of the exact zeta identity.
M4: Any projector rank assumed rather than derived, or normalized trace substituted for ordinary trace without a parent measure.
M5: Any nonzero anomaly sum or globally ill-defined Majorana vertex.
M6: Any no-go conclusion that uses experimental targets or assumptions absent from its declared hypothesis class.
global: Any use of physical observables before the independent mathematical submission is frozen.
